Name: Dispel Magic
Description: Neutralizes magic in a 3" cube: base 50% success, +5% per caster level above the target's level, -2% per level below.
EffectDescription: Removes magical protections (invisibility, mirror image, barkskin, illusions) from the targeted monster group and harmful magic (charm, confusion, slow, web, sleep) from the party. Does not affect enchanted items.
